18 Month Suspended Sentence Given  Canadian MS Patient Krieger for "Drug Trafficking"
For Supplying Medical Marijuana 

From The Toronto Star
lettertoed@thestar.com
http://www.thestar.com/

January 6, 1999

PROBATION FOR POT USE

Marijuana activist Grant Krieger yesterday was handed an 18-month suspended sentence for drug trafficking. Outside Court of Queen’s Bench in Regina, Krieger, 44, who suffers from multiple sclerosis, said he will continue to smoke pot during his probation. He claims the drug has helped mitigate the symptoms of MS, a chronic disease of the nervous system.
